name: Plenoxels Interpolation Methods
definition: Samples voxel values using nearest neighbor, trilinear, or tricubic interpolation to reconstruct the continuous radiance field from discrete voxel grids.
summary: Plenoxels Interpolation Methods define a continuous plenoptic function on a sparse 3D voxel grid by trilinearly interpolating density and spherical harmonic coefficients, ensuring stable gradient-based optimization for radiance fields.
